original.text: ji ltar rlung gis brgyab pas mi g.yo ba'i/ / chu la g.yo bas rba rlabs rnams su 'gyur/ / de ltar rgyal pos mda' bsnun snang ba yang / / gcig nyid na yang rnam pa sna tshogs byed/ /

paraphrase: As unmoving water struck by the wind becomes waves, so the king sees Saraha, though one, in many forms.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: brjod du med na sdug bsngal ma yin te/ / bsgom du med na de nyid bde ba yin/ / ji ltar 'brug gi sgra yis sdangs na yang / / char pa bab pas lo tog smin par byed/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: If it cannot be spoken, it is not suffering; if it cannot be meditated, that itself is bliss; as the dragon's thunder frightens yet its rain ripens the crops.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: dang po tha ma de bzhin gzhan na med/ / thog ma tha ma bar du gnas pa med/ / kun du rtog pas rmongs pa'i yid can la/ / stong pa dang ni snying rje brjod pas so/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Beginning and end are not elsewhere; there is no beginning, end or middle; to the deluded whose minds are full of concepts, emptiness and compassion are taught.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: sems gang dri ma med pa'i rang bzhin la/ / srid dang myang 'das 'dam gyis ma gos so/ / 'dam du bcug na mchog gi rin po che/ / de yi 'od kyang gsal ba ma yin no/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Mind, whose nature is stainless, is not stained by the mud of saṃsāra and nirvāṇa; yet a supreme jewel sunk in mud does not shine.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: ji ltar rmongs pas bzlog nas bltas pa yis/ / mar me gcig nyid gnyis su snang ba ltar/ / de la blta bya lta byed gnyis med la/ / kye ma blo ni gnyis kyi dngos por snang / /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: As the deluded, looking askance, see one lamp as two, so, though there is no seen and seer, alas, the intellect appears as two things.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: kha sbyor bde la yongs su chags nas su/ / 'di nyid don dam yin zhes rmongs pa smra/ / gang zhig khyim nas byung nas sgo drung du/ / kA ma rU pa'i gtam ni 'dri bar byed/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Attached to the bliss of union, the deluded say 'this is the ultimate' — like one who, having come out of the house, asks at the door for news of Kāmarūpa.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: A siddha's own warning against taking sexual bliss for the ultimate; recorded as the text's warning.

original.text: kha cig tshangs pa'i gnas su 'od spar nas/ / lce yis kun du ru yis lce chung bskyod/ / 'ching bar byed pa shin du dkrugs byas te/ / nga rgyal dbang gis rnal 'byor pa zhes zer/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Some raise light at the place of Brahmā and with the tongue — in 'kunduru' (union) — move the uvula, binding and churning violently, and out of pride call themselves yogins.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: Criticizes forceful practices of the head and tongue (the unit notes a resemblance to khecarī-type techniques; not identified in the text).

original.text: rang rig de nyid rig pas gzhan la ston/ / gang gis bcings pa de nyid grol zhes zer/ / kha dog dbye bas 'ching bu margad zer/ / rmongs pas rin cher brtag pa ma shes pas/ / de ni ra gan gser gyi blo yis len/ / nyams myong khyer nas don dam sgrub par byed/ / rmi lam bde la rjes su chags par byed/ / phung po mi rtag bde ba rtag ces zer/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Teaching others self-awareness by awareness, they say 'what binds, that frees'; like the deluded who cannot judge a gem and take brass for gold; they carry away experiences as if achieving the ultimate, cling to dream-bliss and call the bliss of the impermanent aggregates permanent.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: e baM yi ger rang gis go bar byed/ / skad cig dbye bas phyag rgya bzhi bkod cing / / nyams su myong bas lhan cig skyes pa zer/ / gzugs brnyan zhes pa me long lta ba bzhin/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: They understand by themselves the letters E VAṂ, set out the four seals by distinguishing the moments, and call experience 'the innate' — like looking at a reflection in a mirror.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: khyim du mar me mang po sbar gyur kyang / / mig med pa la mun par gnas pa ltar/ / lhan cig skyes pas thams cad khyab byas kyang / / nye yang rmongs pa dag la shin du ring / /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Though many lamps are lit in a house, the blind remain in darkness; though the innate pervades everything and is near, for the deluded it is very far.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: blo dang sems dang sems kyi snang ba de bdag nyid/ / 'jig rten gang dag gzhan du snang ba de bdag nyid/ / sna tshogs ma lus mthong bya mthong byed de bdag nyid/ / chags sdang gti mug byang chub sems kyang de bdag nyid/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Intellect, mind and mind's appearances are that very self; the worlds that appear as other are that very self; all the variety, seen and seer, is that very self; desire, hatred, delusion and bodhicitta are that very self.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: 'bdag nyid' is rendered 'that very self/itself'; not an ātman doctrine in the tradition's reading.

original.text: dgag pa med cing sgrub pa med/ / 'dzin pa med de bsam mi khyab/ / blo yi dbye bas rmongs rnams 'ching / / dbyer med lhan cig skyes rnam dag /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: There is no negation and no affirmation, no grasping — it is inconceivable; the deluded are bound by the intellect's divisions; the undivided innate is wholly pure.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: rjes su chags pa dang ni ma chags pa'i/ / gzugs nyid dag ni stong pa nyid yin no/ / srid pa'i 'dam zhen phag lta bu/ / dri med sems gyur skyon ci yod/ / gang yang dag gis ma gos pa/ / de yang de yis ci phyir 'ching / /

paraphrase: Form itself, attached or unattached, is emptiness; like a pig attached to the mud of existence ... when mind has become stainless, what fault is there? What is not stained by anything, why should it be bound?
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

paraphrase: The many rivers are one in the ocean; many lies are overcome by one truth; one rising sun dispels many darknesses.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: dam pa'i bde ba spangs nas gzhan du 'gro/ / rkyen las skyes pa'i bde la re bar byed/ / rang gi khar bcug sbrang rtsi nye ba ni/ / 'thung bar mi byed shin du ring bar 'gyur/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2263, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Abandoning the holy bliss they go elsewhere and hope for bliss born of conditions; honey put in one's own mouth, near at hand, they do not drink, and it becomes far away.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
